data.content_ref: inline:The target claims that the §11.3 flagging criterion is vacuously satisfied by *any* critic that crashes, rendering the ritual's signal uninformative. However, this assertion contradicts the mechanical verification context, which states that all predicate/program-evaluated commitments currently PASS (failures were refuted mechanically before this call). If a crashed critic vacuously satisfied the criterion, the harness would be unable to mechanically refute failures. The substance of the claim misrepresents the standard by presupposing that crashes satisfy §11.3, when the evaluation framework indicates the criterion is evaluated successfully.
